name: io.paymove/paymove-mcp
title: Paymove MCP Server
description: Official Paymove MCP server for payment links, checkouts, Pay&Go tickets, parking zones, and Polish KSeF e-invoicing.

headers.name: X-API-KEY
headers.description: Paymove Partner API Key generated in https://panel.paymove.io (required for the 19 Partner tools: General, Pay, Pay&Go, Parking).

headers.name: X-SANDBOX-API-KEY
headers.description: Optional Paymove Sandbox API Key (starts with sk_test_) to route operations to the Paymove Sandbox environment.

headers.name: X-KSEF-TOKEN
headers.description: Optional Polish National e-Invoicing System (KSeF) authorization token (containing |nip-XXXXXXXXXX|) for KSeF invoice tools.
